categoryMeta.description: Indoor treadmill workouts for easy running, incline aerobic work, tempo, intervals, progression, and controlled recovery.

workouts.title: Beginner Climate-Controlled 30-Min Jog
workouts.summary: A flat, comfortable 30-minute easy jog on the treadmill, perfect for bad weather or recovery days.
workouts.riskReason: Continuous easy running on a flat, cushioned treadmill deck is low impact.

intensityGuide.paceGuide: Select a comfortable jogging speed. Keep incline at a steady 1.0% to simulate outdoor wind resistance.
intensityGuide.hrGuide: Heart rate stable in Zone 1 or Zone 2, RPE 3-4/10.

warmup.name: Active Warm-up walk
warmup.description: 3 mins progressive walk on the belt, starting at a slow stroll and building to a brisk walk.

mainSet.name: 30-Min Easy Jog
mainSet.description: Run continuously at a relaxed conversational speed on a flat belt (1.0% incline).

cooldown.name: Walking Cooldown
cooldown.description: 3 mins slow walking to let heart rate settle down safely.

easier.description: Reduce running duration to 20 minutes continuous.

mainSet.name: 20-Min Easy Jog
mainSet.description: Maintain a slow steady jog for 20 minutes.

harder.description: Increase running duration to 40 minutes continuous.

mainSet.name: 40-Min Easy Jog
mainSet.description: Maintain a steady conversational pace for 40 minutes.

coachingNotes: Keep your stride short and quick to avoid slipping.
Ensure the safety clip is securely attached to your clothing before starting.
Do not jump off a moving treadmill belt; always let the belt stop completely.
commonMistakes: Running the early miles too fast.
safetyNotes: Achilles and knee joint protection. Do not raise incline past 1.5% without a proper warmup.
Never step off the treadmill while the belt is moving.

shareCard.purposeText: A flat, comfortable easy jog perfect for bad weather or recovery days.

workouts.sourceNote: General running training principles; not personalized medical or coaching advice.

workouts.title: Developing Gentle Incline Aerobic Builder 30-Min
workouts.summary: A progressive incline session composed of gentle climbs to build leg strength and cardiovascular power safely.

workouts.title: Advanced Mountain Hike-Run 45-Min
workouts.summary: An intense steep incline aerobic session designed to build muscular endurance and cardiorespiratory power safely.
workouts.riskReason: Steep incline climbing segments at RPE 6-7 carry moderate calf and Achilles load.

intensityGuide.paceGuide: Steady rhythm, letting effort rise naturally on climbs and keeping incline at 8-10% grade.
intensityGuide.hrGuide: Heart rate stable in Zone 3, rising to Zone 4 inside climbs.

warmup.name: Dynamic Mobilization Warm-up
warmup.description: 5 mins of easy walking and mobility dynamics.

mainSet.name: 5 × Incline Blocks
mainSet.description: Run 5 repetitions of: 3 mins power walk at 8-10% incline + 3 mins easy jog at 1.5% incline.

easier.description: Reduce incline repetitions to 4, keeping grade at 6-8%.

mainSet.name: 4 × Incline Blocks
mainSet.description: Run 4 repetitions of 3 mins walk / 3 mins jog.

harder.description: Increase incline repetitions to 6, keeping grade at 10-12%.

mainSet.name: 6 × Incline Blocks
mainSet.description: Run 6 repetitions of 3 mins walk / 3 mins jog.

coachingNotes: Focus on tall, vertical posture and rhythmic breathing on the climbs.
Let your breathing dictate pace on the climbs.
commonMistakes: Running the steep climbs too aggressively.
safetyNotes: Achilles and calf strain risk. Do not raise incline past 10.0% without a proper warmup.
Never step off the treadmill while the belt is moving.

shareCard.purposeText: An intense steep incline session to build muscular endurance safely.

easier.description: Reduce main set to 2 repetitions with 3-minute walking recoveries.

mainSet.name: 2 × 8-Min Tempo Blocks
mainSet.description: Run 2 reps of 8 minutes, walk 180 seconds.

workouts.title: Intermediate 40-Min Out-and-Back Progression
workouts.summary: A progressive 40-minute continuous run on the treadmill designed to practice pacing discipline.
workouts.riskReason: Structured progressive running introduces moderate muscle fatigue.

intensityGuide.paceGuide: Outward leg warm-up at relaxed conversational pace; return leg has speed increased every 3 minutes to tempo effort. Keep incline at 1.0%.
intensityGuide.hrGuide: Low Zone 2, rising to Zone 3 on return leg.

warmup.name: Dynamic Mobilization Warm-up
warmup.description: 5 mins of easy walking and mobility dynamics.

mainSet.name: Treadmill 36-Min Out-and-Back Progression
mainSet.description: Run 18 minutes gradually building, then 18 minutes settling back down.

easier.description: Reduce running duration to 30 minutes total: 15m out, 15m back.

mainSet.name: Outward Leg: Easy Jog
mainSet.description: Run 15 minutes easy.

mainSet.name: Return Leg: 15-Min Progression
mainSet.description: Run 15 minutes with speed increases.

harder.description: Increase running duration to 50 minutes total: 25m out, 25m back.

mainSet.name: Outward Leg: Easy Jog
mainSet.description: Run 25 minutes easy.

mainSet.name: Return Leg: 25-Min Progression
mainSet.description: Run 25 minutes with speed increases.

coachingNotes: Pacing discipline is key. Do not race the outward leg.
Focus on maintaining a steady rhythm on the return leg.
Practice focusing on a steady breath rhythm as muscles tire.
commonMistakes: Running the outward leg too aggressively.
safetyNotes: Warm up thoroughly before beginning.
Never step off the treadmill while the belt is moving.

shareCard.purposeText: A progressive 40-minute continuous run to build stamina and pacing control.
